title: Sumo Cubes 3D
game_overview: Control a sumo cube in a shrinking arena, charging and pushing the rival off the edge to claim victory across escalating rounds.
winning_condition: Push the opponent cube off the shrinking rectangular ring across rounds to win the tournament.
losing_condition: Your cube is pushed off the ring and falls into the abyss below.

controls.input: W / A / S / D (or Arrow Keys)
controls.action: Move your sumo cube in 3D space across the ring.
Perform a powerful shove dash in the current movement direction to push the rival.
Touch buttons for directional locomotion and shove attack.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Physics-Driven Tactile Combat: Punchy Rapier rigid-body impacts and satisfying impulse collisions between the sumo cubes. 2. Escalating Tension: The rectangular arena gradually shrinks over time, forcing decisive engagements. 3. Responsive Arcade Controls: Intuitive directional movement paired with a timed charge shove mechanic.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Each round starts in a fresh rectangular dohyo ring. The arena steadily shrinks from its perimeter. The player maneuvers their cube to out-position and ram the AI opponent, unleashing timed Spacebar shoves. Knocking the rival off scores points and advances to next rounds with faster, smarter AI.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Cube Locomotion: Snappy physics velocity with dynamic tilting into movement direction. 2. Shove Dash (Spacebar): A momentary high-impulse surge with a brief cooldown, capable of launching the rival when connected cleanly. 3. Shrinking Ring: The rectangular floor shrinks progressively, with warning edge lines and falling perimeter tiles. 4. AI Behavior: The enemy cube tracks the player, attempts counters, and executes proactive pushes while staying within safe boundaries.
sections.summary: Locomotion, shove dash, and shrinking arena dynamics.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: Camera Perspective: Angled top-down isometric view positioned above and back from the arena center with subtle tracking and impact shake. 3D Coordinate Space: Standard Three.js coordinates (+Y is Up, +X is Right, -Z is Forward). Movement Physics: Rapier 3D dynamic rigid bodies with tuned friction, mass, and impulse responses.

sections.title: 3D Scene & Environment Structure
sections.content: The ring is a floating rectangular tatami/wood platform with glowing boundary ribbons. Background features floating lanterns, misty clouds, and subtle cherry blossom particles. High-intensity 3-point lighting highlights the cube faces and visual mawashi belts.
sections.summary: Vibrant Japanese sumo dohyo arena suspended in a stylized stylized atmospheric void.

sections.title: Characters & Customization
sections.content: Player: Blue/Cyan stylized cube with a sumo topknot (chonmage) and golden mawashi belt. Opponent: Crimson/Orange rival cube with fierce eyes and black mawashi belt. Dynamic visual squash on impact.
sections.summary: Charming sumo cubes with expressive stylized designs.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Dash wind trail particles, shockwave rings upon cube collisions, screen shake on heavy shoves, dramatic slow-motion finish upon ring-out, and confetti celebration on round victories.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Responsive virtual joystick / 4-way D-Pad on the bottom left and a large, stylized 'PUSH' button on the bottom right. Wired with onPointerDown, onPointerUp, onPointerLeave, and onPointerCancel with touch-none to prevent browser scroll.
